lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Static in the air tonight
Everything is burning bright
Digital heart start to race
Running through this hollow space
[chorus]
It's a neon rush in my veins
Breaking through the heavy chains
Yeah we're living at the peak
The fire is all we ever seek
[verse]
Current flows beneath the floor
Always craving something more
Shadows dancing on the wall
Waiting for the beat to fall
[chorus]
It's a neon rush in my veins
Breaking through the heavy chains
Yeah we're living at the peak
The fire is all we ever seek
[bridge]
Turn it up until it breaks
Give me all the risks you take
Electric pulse inside the dark
We're the lightning, we're the spark
[chorus]
It's a neon rush in my veins
Breaking through the heavy chains
Yeah we're living at the peak
The fire is all we ever seek
[outro]
